cases.name: Verify Meta Pixel and Conversion API can be added on the Edit profile/Tracking page
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Tracking

steps.desc:
1. open the Edit profile/Tracking page on Pear
2. input Meta Pixel and Conversion API
3. click Save
steps.result:
1. it will save successfully and give a prompt "Update Success"
2. then it will be displayed on the Admin Tool Users>Profile>Account>Tracking
3. it will be displayed on the Meta Pixel Helper
